nodes.title: RedNode Studio 1.7
widgets_values:
**RedNode Studio 1.7**

Open **RedNode Start Here Install** from the template browser first and let ComfyUI Manager install what it offers. It holds one node from each pack this workflow can use, so Manager finds them in one pass instead of one at a time. Restart ComfyUI, then open this workflow.

Without that step the graph opens with missing nodes in red.

**What's new in 1.7**

- **The Workspace node is the panel alone.** It has no input or output sockets any more. They live on the new **RedNode Studio Inputs / Outputs** node, which picks its Workspace from a dropdown and needs no wire to it: the pack joins the two when you queue. Eleven inputs (model, clip, vae, latent, image, the two masks, the four Frame wordings) and seventeen outputs (the workspace bundle, image, result latent, model, clip, vae, positive, negative, denoise, seed, prompt text, negative text, post process, and the rig's steps, cfg, sampler and scheduler for a KSampler on External sampler).
- **Workflows saved before 1.7 need one change.** Any wire that sat on the Workspace is dropped when the workflow loads, and the browser console names it. Add a RedNode Studio Inputs / Outputs node, choose the Workspace, and wire from there. This workflow is already done.
- **Quick start**, a sampler dial: the steps before the grow point run on a half-size latent, then the picture grows and finishes at full size. Krea 2 Turbo at 1064 x 1352 renders in half the time on the same seed. It sits out on image to image, the Detailer, Paint and masked runs. A seed frames a little differently with it on.
- **Unvarnish**, a Post FX card in the Film band: the generated gloss taken down without going dull. Loud colours back, skin de-oranged, gloss down, fine detail up, the source's black and contrast put back.
- **Pores**, a Post FX card: fine skin relief under the skin mask, held back where the skin has detail of its own. A **Natural Skin** look ships with it.
- A lens pick on the Lens distortion card fills the Vignette card too, so one pick sets the glass, its fringing and its corners.
- **Krea 2 Photographic**, a sampler preset: 12 steps, euler and simple at shift 4, Detail Daemon look only, Quick start on.
- The Detailer's **VOSR2** pass takes x1.5, runs x6 and x8 as two passes so skin stays whole, and has a Cache model dial that keeps the model between runs.
- **Picture Info**, a page on the Tools tab: drop in a picture and read how it was made, from A1111, Forge, Neo, ComfyUI or RedNode Studio. Every setting copies on a click, LoRAs show installed or not, and Save a copy writes it for A1111, Neo or Civitai with the hashes. Nothing is uploaded.
- **Keep** follows the version on show: Raw, Before Post or the finished picture, each on its own. S keeps the picture you are looking at, in the Review, its full screen or the Run page. Kept pictures wear gold.
- **Auto name** on the Save page, off by default: the AI tab's vision model titles each picture as it saves, and a %name% chip places the title in the path or the file name. Repeats are numbered.
- The Save page is cards: drafts and keepers before or after your subfolder, the versions saved (Raw Render, Before Post FX, Finished Render) each in a folder named like its button, metadata, and the finish sound.
- The Run page's Live picture has the Raw, Before Post and After Post switch under it, the seed and run time on the top line (click the seed to copy it), and a shorter right-click menu with a gold Keep button.
- A new Workspace links every part of a run to Main on the Seed tab, and so does this workflow, so one seed reproduces the whole picture through the Detailer, Upscale and Post. Rerun with the same seed keeps it.
- The Model, CLIP, VAE page is **Model Groups**. The Subject gallery has a **People cap**, and each person wears a colour and a number.
- The Assistant copes with Ollama 0.40 models that loop under a schema: it asks again in plain JSON, then in free text.
- The pack's code sits in one folder now. Nothing you see changes.


**Node packs this workflow needs**

| Pack | What it does here |
| --- | --- |
| [RedNode Studio](https://github.com/RedNodeAI/ComfyUI-RedNodeStudio) | The Workspace, its Inputs / Outputs node, the rigs, the prompt tools, the shelf, the notes |
| [ComfyUI-GGUF](https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF) | The GGUF text encoder loader on the ZTurbo rig |
| [Krea2-BBOX-Prompter](https://github.com/ukr8b3g-cmyk/Krea2-BBOX-Prompter) | The Light & Color and Scene nodes |
| [ComfyUI-Krea-Moodboards](https://github.com/Andro-Meta/ComfyUI-Krea-Moodboards) | The Style browser |
| [ComfyUI-EulerDiscreteScheduler](https://github.com/erosDiffusion/ComfyUI-EulerDiscreteScheduler) | The FlowMatch scheduler on the ZTurbo rig |
| [Derfuu_ComfyUI_ModdedNodes](https://github.com/Derfuu/Derfuu_ComfyUI_ModdedNodes) | The text node feeding the prompt |

Optional, and only if you switch them on inside the Workspace: the caption engines, the Detailer's and the Upscale page's upscalers and segmenter, Re-render's engines, and the Post tab's depth and mask models. The Workspace Manager's **Check installs** button tells you which of those your own settings call for, and links to each. Nothing there is needed to render.

**Model files**

Put each file in the folder named. Then either press the matching family on **Models > Setup**, or pick the files yourself on **Models > Model Groups**.

*Qwen Image 2.1*, optional, all three from [Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1)

| File | Folder |
| --- | --- |
| `qwen_image_2.1_bf16.safetensors`, or `qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot.safetensors` for a smaller card | `models/diffusion_models` |
| `qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors` | `models/text_encoders` |
| `qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors` | `models/vae` |

Qwen Image 2.1 ships under Alibaba's Qwen research licence: free for personal and research use, not for commercial work without their say. Its VAE belongs to it alone: a Krea 2 rig wants the Wan 2.1 VAE below, and the Workspace says so at load if the two are crossed.

*Diffusion models* into `models/diffusion_models`

| File | Used by | Where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `krea2TurboOfficialComfy_krea2TurboFp8.safetensors` | the Krea2Raw rig | [Krea 2 Turbo Official Comfy-Org Checkpoints](https://civitai.com/models/2726029/krea-2-turbo-official-comfy-org-checkpoints-krea2), the fp8 file |
| `darkBeast_darkblitz6Beyondnsfw.safetensors` | the ZTurbo rig | [on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/justabigduck/my_saves/blob/58f4f01caf3204ad067d3841b51cf4f8e2d5aecb/realistic_models/darkBeast_darkblitz6Beyondnsfw.safetensors) |
| `pornmasterKrea2_v2TurboInt8.safetensors` | the Krea2 rig | [on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/Lucas77077/Krea-2-Models/blob/main/pornmasterKrea2_v2TurboInt8.safetensors) |

The Krea2 rig's file is an INT8 build. If it won't load, set that rig's **Loader** on the Models tab to **INT8 W8A8** and install ComfyUI-INT8-Fast, which the Start Here workflow offers. An INT8 file looks like any other `.safetensors`, so the loader can't tell from the name alone.

*Text encoders* into `models/text_encoders`

| File | Used by | Where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `qwen3VLInstruct4bHeretic_v10.safetensors` | Krea 2 rigs, CLIP type `krea2` | [Qwen3-VL-4b-Heretic for ComfyUI](https://huggingface.co/DreamFast/Qwen3-VL-4b-Heretic-ComfyUI). Any build in there works; pick one your card fits |
| `Qwen3-4B-abliterated_dark.safetensors` | the ZTurbo rig, CLIP type `lumina2` | [Huihui Qwen3-4B-abliterated for ComfyUI](https://huggingface.co/AEmotionStudio/Huihui-Qwen3-4B-abliterated-v2-CLIP), from [huihui-ai/Qwen3-4B-abliterated](https://huggingface.co/huihui-ai/Qwen3-4B-abliterated) |

*VAEs* into `models/vae`

| File | Used by | Where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wan_2.1_vae_fp32.safetensors` | Krea 2 rigs | [Comfy-Org Wan 2.1 VAE](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/tree/main/split_files/vae). That one is the standard build; this workflow uses an fp32 conversion of it |
| `UltraFlux.safetensors` | the ZTurbo rig | [UltraFlux VAE](https://civitai.com/models/2231253/ultraflux-vae-or-improved-quality-for-flux-and-zimage) |

**The rigs**

Three rigs live on the Models tab. One is active at a time and renders.

- **Krea2**: loads its files on the Models tab. 8 steps, cfg 1, euler_ancestral / simple.
- **Krea2Raw**: Your own nodes, running through the `krea2_external` chain on the canvas. Marked as the official Krea 2 Turbo, which is what the identity edit wants.
- **ZTurbo**: Your own nodes, running through the `ZTurbo` chain. 12 steps, cfg 1, euler / simple, with the FlowMatch scheduler and a split sigma pair.

A rig set to **Your own nodes** is driven by the **Built-in sampler**. That sounds backwards and it's worth reading twice: your own sampler does the work, and the Workspace hands it the prompts, the latent, the seed and the numbers through Rig Inputs, then takes the picture back from Rig Result. On **External sampler** the Workspace renders nothing at all and those rigs never run.

The `rig3` chain, in the group marked PLUG YOUR OWN RIG HERE, is an empty slot for your own sampler. Name a rig after it on the Models tab, set that rig to Your own nodes, and it runs.

**Hold two rigs** on the Models tab is off. Turn it on only if you switch between two rigs every run and have the system RAM for both.

**Using it**

1. Pick the rig on the **Models** tab, or build one on **Models > Setup**.
2. Write the prompt on the **Prompts** tab. It renders on whichever rig is active. Pick a LoRA set on the row if that prompt wants different LoRAs.
3. Press **Generate** in the header of any page, and watch the stages, the picture and the memory on the Run tab.
4. The **Workspace Manager**, under Settings on the rail, maps the whole run in the order it happens: green is on, grey is off, amber is on but stood aside, red wants fixing. Hover a box for the reason, click one to open the page that decides it. Workspace presets sit at its top.
5. To wire anything into or out of the Workspace, use the **RedNode Studio Inputs / Outputs** node beside it. The three wording nodes feed it, and its `image` output is where a Detailer, Save or Review of your own would go. The Workspace node itself has no sockets.

Nothing is saved unless **Save** is switched on, on the Run tab. The finished picture still shows in the Live picture and the Review either way.

**VRAM**

Set **VRAM limit** on the Run tab to your card. The line under it says what the run needs with nothing held, and whether it will hold to stay under the limit. Holding is slower but keeps a big rig inside a small card. On a card with room to spare, Free range is faster.
